name: fPSA Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of fPSA using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of free PSA in human serum and plasma samples. lt is mainly used for dynamic monitoring of patients with malignant tumors to assist in judging the disease process or treatment effect. It cannot be used as a basis for early diagnosis of malignant tumors, and is not suitable for tumor screening in the general population. This assay is intended to be used in conjunction with the Getein total PSA test as an aid in distinguishing prostate cancer from benign prostatic conditions in men age 50 years or older who have a digital rectal examination (DRE) that is not suspicious for prostate cancer and the Getein total PSA value between 4 ng/mL and 10 ng/mL.
